theme: incident log line harvest GREPLINES HEADFILE TAILFILE LINECOUNTALL

tests.name: false_friend_ERR
tests.cmd: GREPLINES ERR hits ERR line + both ERROR lines

tests.name: head_ghost_require
tests.cmd: HEADFILE ghost soft exit0; REQUIRE exit2

tests.name: ghost_volume
tests.cmd: LINECOUNTALL ghost → 0 slot MISS=1 SUM partial

weaknesses.title: GREPLINES empty needle matches every line (N=linecount)
weaknesses.detail: Unlike COUNTINFILES empty→0, empty substring is true for all lines. Agent blank ARG harvest floods LINES plate. Opposite polarity of empty-needle family across ops.

weaknesses.title: HEADFILE/TAILFILE n bare numeric var is form error
weaknesses.detail: SYS HEADFILE path n fails with unknown form 'n'; need (n) expr or string var. Literal 2 works. Easy agent trap when peeks are parameterized.
weaknesses.repro: LET n=2; SYS HEADFILE p n → parse fail; SYS HEADFILE p (n) ok

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON harvest bag glues lines without separators
weaknesses.detail: lines plate has NL between ERROR lines; PRINT_JSON → ERROR alpha oneERROR alpha two. Recurring bag JSON collapse.

weaknesses.title: GREPLINES returns bare lines — no path:line provenance
weaknesses.detail: Harvest packet loses which file produced each line. Agents must dual GREPFILES or custom EACH. No GREPLINES --with-filename mode.
weaknesses.repro: FATAL boom alone; multi-file harvest loses source

weaknesses.title: SYS HEAD is bag first field; SYS HEADFILE is file peek
weaknesses.detail: Same trap class as GREP/GREPFILES. Wrong op peeks path bag string not file content.

weaknesses.title: Substring false friends: ERR matches ERROR lines
weaknesses.detail: No whole-word mode on GREPLINES. Short severity needles over-harvest.
weaknesses.repro: GREPLINES ERR → ERR line + ERROR alpha*

weaknesses.title: LINECOUNTALL miss keeps bag length with 0 slots
weaknesses.detail: Useful for ZIP with PATHS but silent zero can look like empty files. MISS counter is the only signal.

weaknesses.title: WRITE trailing NL omitted on last plate field
weaknesses.detail: VOLUME/LINES/PEEK last line often no final $ on cat -A.

workarounds: Reject blank needle before GREPLINES (this board EXIT 2)
Always SYS HEADFILE path (n) not bare n
Read plate files not PRINT_JSON for multiline bags
Pair GREPFILES for provenance if path:line needed
Prefer long needles (ERROR not ERR) for severity harvest
language_gaps: GREPLINES empty needle should miss/zero like COUNTINFILES
HEADFILE accept bare numeric vars without (expr)
HEAD vs HEADFILE naming clarity in help
issues_faced: Bare HEADFILE n parse fail blocked first head/tail tests — fixed with (peek_want)
Empty GREPLINES polarity opposite COUNTINFILES — documented
